title: Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan open-sourced his personal AI knowledge system

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: by Combinator CEO Gary Tan open sourced his personal AI knowledge system. Gbrain is long-term memory for AI agents. Everything you know, people, companies, deals, meetings, stored as markdown files in a git repo. While you sleep, it scans your conversations, emails, meeting transcripts, enriches entities, creates cross references, builds a knowledge graph. You wake up. Your digital brain got smarter overnight.
